run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the sum of largest prime factors for all numbers up to n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input values to verify correctness of prime factor sum calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses a sieve approach to find largest prime factors
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder with an equivalent implementation
review_f_gold: review the f_gold sieve-based algorithm for computing largest prime factor sums
